name: claude-docs-changelog
tagline_zh: 别翻烂 Git 日志了，一条命令把近期文档改动变成带交互按钮的 HTML 报告，还能一键生成学习路径。
tagline_en: Stop digging through git logs. Turn recent doc changes into a stunning HTML report with interactive course.
desc_en: Generate a self-contained HTML changelog report showing recent documentation changes with interactive course generation buttons. Use this skill when the user asks for a docs changelog, documentation report, what changed recently, recent doc updates as a report, or runs `/docs --report`. Discovers changes via git history, categorizes them, summarizes what's new, and produces a stunning Obsidian & A
why_zh: 同类只会列 diff，它用 git 历史自动分类、总结，并生成可点击的学习路径，让 changelog。
why_en: Unlike plain diff lists, it auto-categorizes git history, summarizes changes, and generates clickable learning paths—turning.
